Security and Infrastructure Testing
Home
Security and Infrastructure Testing
Safeguard Your Digital Landscape
Strengthen Security. Reduce Risk. Protect What Matters.
As applications, cloud environments and digital services become increasingly connected, security vulnerabilities can expose organisations to data breaches, operational disruption and reputational damage.
Market Cloud’s
Security Testing services
help organisations proactively identify vulnerabilities, assess security controls and strengthen their overall security posture.
Our approach combines structured security testing with quality engineering and modern technology expertise to help uncover risks before they become costly incidents.
Protect Sensitive Data
Validate security controls designed to reduce unauthorised access and protect business-critical information.
Penetration Testing
Evaluate applications and systems from an attacker’s perspective to identify exploitable weaknesses and validate existing security controls.
Vulnerability Assessment
Detect known vulnerabilities, outdated components, insecure configurations and other weaknesses that may increase security exposure.
Attack Simulation
Simulate realistic attack scenarios to evaluate how effectively applications, infrastructure and security controls respond.
Security Risk Assessment
Evaluate threats, vulnerabilities and potential business impact to help teams prioritise security improvements.
Security Testing Services
Protect Your Assets from Every Angle
Infrastructure Security Testing
Security Testing Beyond the Application Layer
Network security assessment

Cloud configuration testing

Identity and permission review

Modern business systems rely on connected infrastructure, cloud environments, networks and integrations.
Market Cloud extends security testing beyond individual applications to assess the wider technology environment.
Strengthen Security Before Risks Become Incidents
Get a Consultation
Security Testing Capabilities
Application Security
Assess web applications, APIs and digital platforms for security weaknesses and insecure behaviour.
Infrastructure Security
Evaluate servers, networks, endpoints and supporting systems for vulnerabilities and configuration risks.
Cloud Security
Review cloud workloads, access permissions and configuration controls to reduce unnecessary exposure.
Network Security
Assess network architecture, firewalls and connectivity controls for potential weaknesses.
Identity & Access Security
Validate authentication, authorisation, privileged access and permission models.
Vulnerability Management
Identify, classify and prioritise security weaknesses based on severity and business impact.
Security Configuration Review
Assess system and infrastructure configurations against appropriate security practices.
